introen: Follow local angular changes on selected surface structures across slopes, reservoirs, dams and coastal works. Match each monitoring point to a defined structural element, then compare its angle history with the project’s inspections and independent observations.
introzh: 从工程边坡、库岸支挡到坝段与海堤，在选定表面构件上持续记录局部倾角。明确每个测点对应的结构部位，将角度趋势与项目巡检及独立观测记录对照。
title: Slopes, dams & coastal structures / 边坡大坝与海岸工程

scenes.en: Observe gradual rotation of selected concrete facing panels, retaining beams or other engineered surface elements on a cut slope. A consistent installation reference helps the project team compare angle trends through excavation, drainage maintenance and seasonal exposure. Link each reading to its specific slope section so inspections can focus on the corresponding structural element.
scenes.zh: 在工程边坡选定的混凝土护面、支挡梁或其他表面结构构件上，观察缓慢发生的转角变化。以一致的安装基准对照开挖、排水维护及季节变化期间的倾角趋势，并将测点与具体坡段对应，帮助团队有针对性地检查相关构件及周边状况。
scenes.pointen: Secure to the engineer-selected facing panel or retaining beam.
scenes.pointzh: 固定于工程师选定的护面板或支挡梁。
scenes.briefen: Facing layout; excavation stages; selected structural element; maintenance access.
scenes.briefzh: 护面布置；开挖阶段；被测构件；维护通道。
scenes.imagebrief: 真实工程切坡与混凝土格构护面，侧向构图呈现坡脚、排水沟及维护通道，避免纯自然山体远景。
scenes.alten: Engineered cut slope with concrete lattice facing and drainage channel.
scenes.altzh: 带混凝土格构护面及排水沟的工程边坡。
scenes.title: Engineered cut-slope surface elements / 工程边坡表面构件

scenes.en: Track the local tilt of retaining walls supporting embankments or industrial platforms. Readings from identified wall sections provide a repeatable angle history during nearby earthworks, changes in loading and maintenance. Use the trend alongside wall inspections and project survey records to help engineers assess where closer examination of the structure is needed.
scenes.zh: 监测堤岸或工业平台支挡墙的局部倾角。为各墙段建立清晰的测点对应关系，在邻近土方施工、荷载变化和维护期间形成可对照的角度记录。结合墙体巡检及项目测量资料，帮助工程人员确定需要进一步检查的墙段。
scenes.pointen: Fix to the selected retaining-wall body at the specified orientation.
scenes.pointzh: 按指定方向固定于选定挡墙墙体。
scenes.briefen: Wall type; retained height; nearby loading; construction sequence; mounting surface.
scenes.briefzh: 挡墙形式；支挡高度；邻近荷载；施工顺序；安装表面。
scenes.imagebrief: 真实堤岸或工业平台挡墙近中景，呈现墙身、分缝和上方支承区域，避开公路车道构图，结构细节自然清楚。
scenes.alten: Concrete retaining wall supporting an embankment or industrial platform.
scenes.altzh: 支挡堤岸或工业平台的混凝土挡墙。
scenes.title: Embankment & industrial-platform retaining walls / 堤岸与工业平台支挡墙

scenes.en: Monitor local angular changes on engineered retaining or facing elements at selected open-pit benches. Clearly identified measurement points help mine teams compare the same structural locations through successive excavation stages and inspection rounds. Pair the angle record with the mine’s separate geotechnical observations to support review of the monitored surface structures.
scenes.zh: 在露天矿台阶选定的工程支挡或护面构件上记录局部倾角变化。通过明确的测点编号和构件对应关系，便于矿山团队在分期开挖及多轮巡检中对照同一位置的角度趋势，并结合矿区独立开展的岩土观测，评估相关表面结构的变化。
scenes.pointen: Mount on a designed facing or retaining element selected for monitoring.
scenes.pointzh: 安装于监测设计选定的护面或支挡构件。
scenes.briefen: Bench arrangement; monitored element; excavation schedule; blasting schedule; access conditions.
scenes.briefzh: 台阶布置；被测构件；开挖计划；爆破安排；通行条件。
scenes.imagebrief: 真实露天矿多级台阶中景，重点呈现局部喷混凝土护面与支挡区域，保留检修道路，避免只拍采矿机械。
scenes.alten: Open-pit benches with an engineered facing section and access road.
scenes.altzh: 带工程护面区及检修道路的露天矿台阶。
scenes.title: Open-pit bench surface structures / 露天矿台阶表面监测构件

scenes.en: Follow the inclination of selected sea-dike facing elements, crest walls or associated concrete structures. Establish a reference for each monitored section and compare its angle history before and after storm periods or maintenance. This gives coastal maintenance teams a traceable record of local structural rotation to review alongside scheduled inspections.
scenes.zh: 在海堤选定的护面构件、堤顶防浪墙或附属混凝土结构上记录倾角。为各测点建立参考基准，对照风暴天气前后及维护期间的角度变化，形成可追溯的局部转动记录，供海岸设施维护团队结合定期巡检安排分析。
scenes.pointen: Attach to the monitored concrete element using a site-approved fixing.
scenes.pointzh: 采用现场认可的固定方式安装于被测混凝土构件。
scenes.briefen: Structural section; salt-spray exposure; storm inspection plan; fixing material; access windows.
scenes.briefzh: 结构断面；盐雾暴露；风暴后巡检计划；固定件材质；可作业时段。
scenes.imagebrief: 真实海堤堤顶防浪墙与混凝土护面，斜向构图带出海面和巡检道，晴朗自然光，结构尺度真实。
scenes.alten: Concrete sea-dike facing, crest wall and coastal inspection path.
scenes.altzh: 海堤混凝土护面、防浪墙与巡检道。
scenes.title: Sea-dike facing and associated structures / 海堤护面与附属结构

scenes.en: Measure local angle changes at designated surfaces of concrete dam blocks. Consistent measurement axes and a documented baseline help engineers compare individual points across operating periods, maintenance stages and independent survey campaigns. The resulting angle history adds a clearly located observation to the dam’s wider structural monitoring and inspection programme.
scenes.zh: 在混凝土坝段指定表面测量局部倾角变化。通过统一的测量轴向和有记录的初始基准，便于工程人员对照不同运行阶段、维护期间及独立测量时段的读数，为大坝整体监测与巡检工作增加位置明确、可持续追踪的角度观测信息。
scenes.pointen: Fix directly to the designated dam-block surface at the surveyed orientation.
scenes.pointzh: 按确定的轴向固定于指定坝段表面。
scenes.briefen: Dam-block reference; measurement axes; mounting elevation; inspection access; existing monitoring plan.
scenes.briefzh: 坝段编号；测量轴向；安装高程；巡检通道；既有监测方案。
scenes.imagebrief: 真实混凝土大坝坝段近中景，呈现坝体分缝与检修走道，以侧光表现混凝土材质，避免水库航拍替代。
scenes.alten: Concrete dam blocks with visible joints and an inspection walkway.
scenes.altzh: 可见分缝与检修走道的混凝土坝段。
scenes.title: Concrete dam-block surfaces / 混凝土坝段表面

scenes.en: Observe the inclination of selected retaining walls or engineered support elements along a reservoir bank. Identify each point by bank section and structural component, then compare its angle record with inspections, maintenance and reservoir operating records. This helps teams review local structural changes at the monitored shoreline locations over time.
scenes.zh: 观察水库岸坡选定挡墙或工程支护构件的倾角。按岸段和结构部位标识每个测点，将角度记录与巡检、维护及水库运行记录按时间对照，便于团队持续查看受监测岸段的局部结构变化，安排相应检查。
scenes.pointen: Secure to the selected shoreline retaining wall or structural support element.
scenes.pointzh: 固定于选定的库岸挡墙或结构支护构件。
scenes.briefen: Bank section; retaining form; water-level exposure zone; shoreline access; maintenance programme.
scenes.briefzh: 库岸位置；支挡形式；水位影响区；岸边通行；维护计划。
scenes.imagebrief: 真实水库岸边混凝土挡墙中景，保留水面、岸坡和巡检通道，清晰展示被监测结构，避免自然湖岸风光图。
scenes.alten: Reservoir shoreline retaining wall beside a maintenance path.
scenes.altzh: 水库岸边挡墙与维护通道。
scenes.title: Reservoir-bank retaining structures / 水库岸坡支挡

introen: Keep a consistent angle record for selected railway, tunnel and metro structures. Define the structural element, measurement direction and access arrangements so project teams can compare local rotation through construction, operation and planned maintenance activities.
introzh: 为铁路、隧道与地铁指定结构建立持续的角度记录。明确被测构件、测量方向和现场作业安排，帮助项目团队对照施工、运营及计划维护期间的局部转角变化。
title: Railways, tunnels & metro / 铁路隧道与地铁

scenes.en: Monitor local inclination on selected retaining walls and fixed support structures beside railway lines. Assign each point to a railway location and wall section, then compare trends through adjacent construction and maintenance periods. The angle record helps infrastructure teams relate observations to their existing route inspections and project monitoring programme.
scenes.zh: 在铁路沿线选定的挡墙及固定支撑结构上监测局部倾角。将各测点与线路位置、具体墙段对应，对照邻近施工及维护期间的角度趋势，帮助基础设施团队把观测结果与既有线路巡检和项目监测工作衔接。
scenes.pointen: Install on the designated trackside retaining wall or fixed structural member.
scenes.pointzh: 安装于指定路侧挡墙或固定结构构件。
scenes.briefen: Railway location; wall section; adjacent works; possession windows; communication route.
scenes.briefzh: 线路位置；墙段编号；邻近工程；施工天窗；通信路径。
scenes.imagebrief: 真实铁路路侧挡墙中景，前景结构清晰、背景有钢轨与接触网，镜头位于安全维护区，避免列车特写。
scenes.alten: Railway line beside a concrete trackside retaining wall.
scenes.altzh: 铁路线旁的混凝土支挡墙。
scenes.title: Railway trackside retaining structures / 铁路路侧支挡结构

scenes.en: Track slow changes in the inclination of designated catenary support masts. A documented mounting direction and baseline allow teams to compare the same mast across maintenance activities, nearby ground works and routine inspection rounds. Associate each sensor with the infrastructure asset reference to keep remote angle observations connected to the correct support.
scenes.zh: 监测指定接触网支柱缓慢发生的倾角变化。记录安装方向和初始基准，便于团队对照维护作业、附近地面施工及日常巡检期间同一支柱的读数。将传感器与设施资产编号关联，使远程角度记录准确对应到具体支柱。
scenes.pointen: Secure to the mast at the operator-approved position and orientation.
scenes.pointzh: 固定于运营方批准的支柱位置，并按指定轴向安装。
scenes.briefen: Mast type; asset reference; approved mounting zone; electrical clearances; maintenance access.
scenes.briefzh: 支柱类型；资产编号；允许安装区；电气安全间距；维护通行。
scenes.imagebrief: 真实电气化铁路接触网支柱中景，清楚展示支柱本体与基础，导线和绝缘子比例正确，避免输电塔代替。
scenes.alten: Railway catenary support mast, base and overhead contact wires.
scenes.altzh: 铁路接触网支柱、基础及架空接触线。
scenes.title: Catenary support masts / 接触网支柱

scenes.en: For an engineered monitoring project, record slow angular changes on a designated track-support slab or base element. The railway operator’s approved fixing, measurement axes and reference conditions keep observations comparable across inspection periods. Coordinate acquisition with the project’s operating conditions so engineers can review the static angle trend at each selected point.
scenes.zh: 在工程专项监测中，记录指定轨道支承板或基础构件的缓慢转角变化。采用铁路运营方批准的固定方式，明确测量轴向及参考条件，并结合项目运行条件安排采集，便于工程人员在各巡检时段对照同一测点的静态角度趋势。
scenes.pointen: Use an engineered fixing on the approved slab or base-element location.
scenes.pointzh: 采用专项设计的固定方式安装于获批支承板或基础构件位置。
scenes.briefen: Slab type; measurement axes; reference conditions; fastening design; operator approval.
scenes.briefzh: 支承板形式；测量轴向；参考条件；固定设计；运营方审批。
scenes.imagebrief: 真实无砟轨道支承板局部近景，展示钢轨、扣件与混凝土板的合理关系，预留板侧观察区，不放产品或角度箭头。
scenes.alten: Ballastless track with concrete support slabs and rail fastenings.
scenes.altzh: 带混凝土支承板与扣件的无砟轨道。
scenes.title: Static rotation of track-support slabs / 轨道支承板静态转角

scenes.en: Follow local angular changes on designated tunnel lining sections or individual segments. Establish the installation reference before the relevant works, then compare readings through excavation stages, nearby construction or operating inspections. Keeping each point linked to its lining ring and position helps engineers interpret angle trends within the tunnel’s wider monitoring programme.
scenes.zh: 跟踪指定隧道衬砌段或单块管片的局部倾角变化。在相关作业开始前建立安装基准，随后对照开挖阶段、邻近施工或运营巡检期间的读数。将测点与管片环号和具体位置关联，便于工程人员结合隧道整体监测资料理解角度趋势。
scenes.pointen: Attach to the specified lining segment at the designed measurement orientation.
scenes.pointzh: 按设计测量方向安装于指定衬砌管片。
scenes.briefen: Lining form; ring and segment reference; construction stages; fixing constraints; underground communication path.
scenes.briefzh: 衬砌形式；环号与管片编号；施工阶段；固定限制；地下通信路径。
scenes.imagebrief: 真实盾构隧道内部，清晰展示连续管片环、接缝和维护走道，灯光自然、透视合理，避免奇异变形管片。
scenes.alten: Segmental tunnel lining with visible joints and a maintenance walkway.
scenes.altzh: 接缝清晰的隧道管片与维护走道。
scenes.title: Tunnel lining and segments / 隧道衬砌与管片

scenes.en: Observe the inclination of selected portal walls, headwalls or engineered support members at a tunnel entrance. A point-specific angle history helps teams compare structural response through staged excavation, changes to temporary works and permanent construction. Review the record alongside the project’s inspections and construction sequence for the corresponding portal element.
scenes.zh: 观察隧道入口选定洞门墙、端墙或工程支护构件的倾角。为具体构件持续记录角度，便于团队对照分阶段开挖、临时工程调整和永久结构施工期间的变化，并结合相应洞口构件的巡检记录及施工顺序开展分析。
scenes.pointen: Fix to the designated portal wall or structural support member.
scenes.pointzh: 固定于指定洞口墙体或结构支护构件。
scenes.briefen: Portal arrangement; support stage; monitored member; work sequence; installation access.
scenes.briefzh: 洞口布置；支护阶段；被测构件；作业顺序；安装通行。
scenes.imagebrief: 真实山岭隧道洞口工程中景，呈现混凝土洞门、侧墙及支护区域，施工秩序真实，避免只拍公路入口远景。
scenes.alten: Tunnel portal with concrete headwall and engineered support structures.
scenes.altzh: 带混凝土端墙与工程支护结构的隧道洞口。
scenes.title: Tunnel portals and support elements / 隧道洞口与支护构件

scenes.en: Monitor local tilt on selected metro station columns and fixed structural elements. Link each point to its station level and structural grid so angle changes can be reviewed through adjacent excavation, station modifications or planned maintenance. A consistent reference supports comparison between project stages and helps the responsible team organise targeted structural inspections.
scenes.zh: 在地铁车站选定立柱及固定结构构件上监测局部倾角。以楼层和结构轴网明确测点位置，对照邻近开挖、车站改造及计划维护期间的角度变化。一致的参考基准有助于比较不同工程阶段的读数，并支持负责团队安排针对性的结构检查。
scenes.pointen: Mount on the selected structural column or specified fixed station element.
scenes.pointzh: 安装于选定结构立柱或指定车站固定构件。
scenes.briefen: Station level; structural grid; adjacent work phases; public-area restrictions; communication route.
scenes.briefzh: 车站楼层；结构轴网；邻近施工阶段；公共区域限制；通信路径。
scenes.imagebrief: 真实现代地下车站中景，突出混凝土立柱、顶梁与站台结构，空间比例自然，避免商业大厅或站外列车图片。
scenes.alten: Metro station platform with structural columns and overhead beams.
scenes.altzh: 带结构立柱与顶梁的地铁站台。
scenes.title: Metro station columns and structures / 地铁车站立柱与结构

introen: Follow local angle changes at selected bridge, roadside and waterfront structures. A recorded baseline and consistent observation conditions help engineers relate each point’s trend to inspection findings, nearby works and the structure’s operating environment.
introzh: 在桥梁、公路支挡结构和港口设施的选定构件上记录局部倾角变化。结合安装基准、可比观测条件、现场巡检和邻近施工记录，帮助工程团队持续了解同一点位的变化。
title: Bridges, roads & ports / 桥梁公路与港口

scenes.en: Track gradual angle changes at a selected bridge pier or tower member, with the sensor rigidly coupled to the member being observed. Establish a baseline after installation and compare readings under documented conditions. Linking each point to traffic conditions, maintenance activities and inspection records helps the bridge team review persistent changes and plan focused site checks.
scenes.zh: 在选定桥墩或桥塔构件上刚性固定传感器，记录安装点的缓慢倾角变化。安装后建立基准，并在已记录的可比条件下对照读数。将每个点位与交通状况、维护作业和巡检记录关联，帮助桥梁团队梳理持续变化，安排有针对性的现场复核。
scenes.pointen: A rigid mounting location on the selected pier or tower member.
scenes.pointzh: 选定桥墩或桥塔构件上的刚性安装点。
scenes.briefen: Member identification; monitoring axis; access arrangement; baseline observation conditions.
scenes.briefzh: 构件编号；监测轴向；现场通行方式；基准观测条件。
scenes.imagebrief: 真实跨江桥梁侧面摄影，前景清楚呈现桥墩与墩顶连接，背景保留桥塔及桥面结构。
scenes.alten: Bridge pier and tower supporting a river crossing.
scenes.altzh: 跨江桥梁的桥墩与桥塔构件。
scenes.title: Bridge piers & tower members / 桥墩与桥塔选定构件

scenes.en: Observe local rotation at a selected bridge abutment or wing wall where approach works, drainage conditions or nearby excavation form part of the monitoring brief. Mount directly to the chosen structural element and record its initial orientation. Compare the angle history with site inspection and maintenance records to support reviews of changes at that specific location.
scenes.zh: 对桥台或翼墙的指定点位开展局部转角监测，适用于需要结合桥头施工、排水状况或邻近开挖进行观察的项目。传感器直接固定于所选结构并记录初始姿态；将倾角历史与现场巡检和维护记录对照，为该点位变化的工程复核提供依据。
scenes.pointen: A designated face of the abutment or a selected wing-wall section.
scenes.pointzh: 桥台指定侧面或选定翼墙墙段。
scenes.briefen: Abutment or wall drawing; backfill and drainage layout; nearby works schedule; mounting access.
scenes.briefzh: 桥台或翼墙图纸；回填与排水布置；邻近施工计划；安装通行条件。
scenes.imagebrief: 真实公路桥头斜侧视摄影，完整展示混凝土桥台、翼墙及连接路堤，保持现场自然比例。
scenes.alten: Concrete bridge abutment and wing wall beside an approach embankment.
scenes.altzh: 公路桥台、翼墙与桥头路堤。
scenes.title: Bridge abutments & wing walls / 桥台与翼墙

scenes.en: Record inclination at an engineer-selected point on a bridge-deck member to follow gradual rotation across planned observation periods. Use a rigid connection to the member and document the measurement axis. Comparing observations under similar traffic and operating conditions helps engineers review angular trends alongside their separate inspection and structural measurement records.
scenes.zh: 在工程师选定的桥面结构构件上记录安装点倾角，观察计划周期内的缓慢转角变化。安装时与被测构件刚性连接，明确测量轴向；在交通和运行条件相近时进行对比，并结合独立巡检及结构测量记录，帮助工程团队分析角度变化趋势。
scenes.pointen: A designated rigid location on the monitored deck member.
scenes.pointzh: 被测桥面结构构件上的指定刚性点位。
scenes.briefen: Deck-member drawing; rotation axis; comparable vehicle-loading conditions; observation schedule.
scenes.briefzh: 桥面构件图纸；转角方向；可比车辆荷载条件；观测时间安排。
scenes.imagebrief: 真实桥梁检修视角摄影，清晰呈现桥面下方主梁与横梁连接，画面结构关系准确自然。
scenes.alten: Underside of a bridge deck showing main girders and cross-members.
scenes.altzh: 桥面下方的主梁与横梁构件。
scenes.title: Selected bridge-deck rotation points / 桥面结构指定点转角

scenes.en: Monitor gradual angle changes at selected highway retaining-wall sections along cuttings, ramps or embankments. Give each sensor a wall-section reference and establish its baseline after mounting. Comparing point histories with drainage inspections, rainfall records and nearby earthworks helps maintenance teams decide which locations merit closer examination during scheduled corridor inspections.
scenes.zh: 在路堑、匝道或路堤沿线的选定挡墙墙段上监测缓慢倾角变化。为每台传感器绑定墙段编号，安装后建立基准；将点位历史与排水巡检、已有降雨记录及邻近土方作业对照，帮助维护团队在道路巡检时确定需要进一步查看的位置。
scenes.pointen: A rigid surface on the selected retaining-wall section.
scenes.pointzh: 选定挡墙墙段上的刚性表面。
scenes.briefen: Wall type and section layout; drainage locations; roadside access restrictions; monitoring directions.
scenes.briefzh: 挡墙类型与分段布置；排水位置；路侧作业限制；监测方向。
scenes.imagebrief: 真实山地公路侧向摄影，展示道路旁连续混凝土挡墙、泄水孔和坡面，避免夸张险情。
scenes.alten: Highway retaining wall with drainage outlets beside a mountain road.
scenes.altzh: 山区公路旁带泄水孔的挡墙。
scenes.title: Highway retaining walls / 公路挡墙

scenes.en: Follow local rotation at a selected quay-wall element during routine port operation or nearby construction. Rigidly couple the sensor to the monitored wall element, then record its baseline and orientation. Reviewing observations against documented tidal conditions, loading arrangements and inspection findings helps the port team compare the same location across successive monitoring periods.
scenes.zh: 在港口日常运行或邻近施工期间，观察选定码头岸壁构件的局部转角。传感器与被测墙体刚性连接，记录初始基准和安装方向；结合已有潮位条件、作业荷载安排及现场检查结果，对比同一点位在不同监测周期内的角度变化。
scenes.pointen: A selected rigid quay-wall element accessible from the working side.
scenes.pointzh: 作业侧可接近的选定岸壁刚性构件。
scenes.briefen: Quay-wall type; tidal exposure; operating-load conditions; corrosion and mounting requirements.
scenes.briefzh: 岸壁结构类型；潮汐暴露条件；作业荷载条件；防腐与固定要求。
scenes.imagebrief: 真实港口岸线斜向摄影，清楚展示混凝土岸壁与码头面连接，背景为正常作业港区。
scenes.alten: Concrete quay wall and working apron along an operating port.
scenes.altzh: 港口混凝土岸壁与码头作业面。
scenes.title: Local quay-wall rotation / 码头岸壁局部转角

scenes.en: Observe gradual inclination changes at selected fixed supports of a jetty. Attach to the structural member identified in the monitoring plan and establish a repeatable baseline. Comparing observations made under documented water-level and operating conditions helps engineers review that support’s angular history alongside inspection records and planned maintenance activities.
scenes.zh: 在固定式栈桥的选定支承构件上观察缓慢倾角变化。按监测方案确定被测构件，刚性安装并建立可重复对照的基准；结合已记录的水位和运行条件，将该支承的角度历史与结构巡检及维护计划关联，便于工程团队持续复核。
scenes.pointen: A designated fixed pile, column or support member.
scenes.pointzh: 指定的固定桩柱或结构支承构件。
scenes.briefen: Support-member geometry; tidal access window; vessel-operation periods; marine exposure conditions.
scenes.briefzh: 支承构件尺寸；潮汐作业窗口；船舶作业时段；海洋暴露环境。
scenes.imagebrief: 真实沿海栈桥侧面摄影，突出固定桩柱、横梁与桥面连接，水面平静且结构比例可信。
scenes.alten: Fixed piles and beams supporting a coastal jetty.
scenes.altzh: 沿海栈桥的固定桩柱与支承梁。
scenes.title: Fixed jetty support structures / 固定式栈桥支承结构

introen: Record local angle changes through excavation, erection and temporary-work stages. Match each mounting point to a named structural element, and establish baselines before the relevant activities so engineers can compare observations with site records and planned inspections.
introzh: 围绕基坑开挖、结构安装和临时工程各阶段，记录指定构件的局部倾角变化。将安装点对应到明确构件，在相关作业前建立基准，便于与施工记录和现场检查相互对照。
title: Construction & temporary works / 施工与临时工程

scenes.en: Track local wall rotation at designated retaining-wall points as excavation and support installation progress. Secure each sensor to the selected wall element and record its orientation before the relevant work stage. Relating angle trends to excavation depth, support changes and inspection records helps engineers review how those monitored points respond throughout the construction sequence.
scenes.zh: 随基坑开挖和支撑安装推进，在指定围护墙点位记录局部转角。传感器固定于选定墙体构件，并在相关施工阶段开始前记录安装方向和基准；结合开挖深度、支撑调整及现场检查记录，帮助工程师梳理各监测点随施工进程出现的变化。
scenes.pointen: A designated rigid face of the retaining-wall element.
scenes.pointzh: 围护墙指定构件的刚性表面。
scenes.briefen: Retaining-wall system; excavation stages; support sequence; required measurement axes.
scenes.briefzh: 围护体系；开挖分层计划；支撑施工顺序；所需测量轴向。
scenes.imagebrief: 真实城市深基坑高处俯视摄影，清晰呈现围护墙和多层支撑，施工状态与尺度合理。
scenes.alten: Excavation retaining walls with installed horizontal supports.
scenes.altzh: 设有水平支撑的基坑围护墙。
scenes.title: Excavation retaining walls / 基坑围护墙

scenes.en: Observe inclination at a selected member of a temporary support tower during defined construction stages. Use a rigid attachment to that member and establish a baseline after assembly checks. Correlating angle records with planned loading, configuration changes and routine inspections helps the site team review persistent changes at the named monitoring point.
scenes.zh: 在临时支撑塔架的选定构件上监测指定施工阶段的倾角变化。完成组装检查后，与被测构件刚性连接并建立基准；将角度记录与计划荷载、结构配置调整及日常巡检对照，帮助现场团队复核该点位持续出现的变化并形成可追溯记录。
scenes.pointen: A named structural leg or other rigid tower member.
scenes.pointzh: 已编号的塔架立腿或其他刚性构件。
scenes.briefen: Tower arrangement; assembly stage; loading sequence; component and connection details.
scenes.briefzh: 塔架布置；组装阶段；加载顺序；构件及连接节点信息。
scenes.imagebrief: 真实大型施工现场摄影，完整呈现临时钢支撑塔架及底座，结构连接清楚且无人员冒险。
scenes.alten: Temporary steel support towers with visible legs and base connections.
scenes.altzh: 临时钢支撑塔架与底部连接。
scenes.title: Temporary support towers / 临时支撑塔架

scenes.en: Provide angle records at engineer-selected members of a designed falsework or formwork support system. Establish the point baseline after the agreed assembly checks, then compare observations through planned loading and unloading stages. Linking each reading to a specific member and work stage supports the engineering team’s inspection and review of the temporary works.
scenes.zh: 依据工程设计，在模板或高支模支撑体系的选定构件上记录倾角。完成约定的组装检查后建立点位基准，在计划加载和卸载阶段对照观测；将每条读数对应到具体构件及施工阶段，为工程团队开展临时工程巡检与复核提供补充记录。
scenes.pointen: An engineer-selected upright or rigid support-frame member.
scenes.pointzh: 工程师选定的立杆或刚性支架构件。
scenes.briefen: Engineered support layout; member designation; pour or loading sequence; installation clearance.
scenes.briefzh: 经设计的支撑布置；构件编号；浇筑或加载顺序；安装净空。
scenes.imagebrief: 真实建筑施工内部摄影，呈现规则高支模立杆、水平杆与顶托，节点清晰且布局规范。
scenes.alten: Formwork support frame with uprights, bracing and top supports.
scenes.altzh: 模板支架的立杆、斜撑与顶托。
scenes.title: Falsework & formwork support frames / 模板及高支模支架

scenes.en: Follow inclination at a designated steel column as erection, temporary bracing and connection work progress. Rigidly mount to the chosen column member and record the baseline at an agreed stage. Comparing point readings with erection logs and independent alignment surveys helps the construction team review gradual angle changes between documented stages of assembly.
scenes.zh: 在钢结构立柱安装、临时支撑和节点连接过程中，记录指定立柱安装点的倾角。传感器与被测立柱刚性连接，在约定阶段建立基准；将点位读数与安装日志及独立校正测量对照，帮助施工团队复核不同组装阶段之间的缓慢角度变化。
scenes.pointen: A designated rigid mounting face on the selected steel column.
scenes.pointzh: 选定钢立柱上的指定刚性安装面。
scenes.briefen: Column section; erection sequence; bracing and connection stages; survey reference plan.
scenes.briefzh: 立柱截面；吊装顺序；支撑及节点施工阶段；独立测量基准方案。
scenes.imagebrief: 真实钢结构厂房施工摄影，清楚展示已安装立柱、柱脚与临时支撑，避免悬吊危险构图。
scenes.alten: Erected steel columns with base plates and temporary bracing.
scenes.altzh: 已安装钢立柱、柱脚与临时支撑。
scenes.title: Steel-column erection stages / 钢结构立柱安装阶段

scenes.en: Observe local angle changes at selected building elements beside excavation, tunnelling or other nearby works. Establish a baseline before the relevant construction activity and identify each point in the building record. Comparing trends with the works schedule and independent building inspections helps engineers review changes at the monitored elements as the project advances.
scenes.zh: 在邻近基坑、隧道或其他施工作业的建筑物上，选择指定构件观察局部倾角变化。相关施工开始前建立基准，并将点位写入建筑监测记录；结合施工进度和独立建筑巡检对照趋势，便于工程师在项目推进期间复核被测构件的变化。
scenes.pointen: A selected structural wall, column or other designated rigid element.
scenes.pointzh: 选定结构墙、立柱或其他指定刚性构件。
scenes.briefen: Building structure and condition; distance to works; mounting permission; pre-work baseline period.
scenes.briefzh: 建筑结构及现状；与施工区域距离；安装许可；施工前基准观测期。
scenes.imagebrief: 真实城市施工街景摄影，画面并列呈现既有建筑外墙与邻近围挡，保持完整建筑关系。
scenes.alten: Existing building beside a construction-site boundary.
scenes.altzh: 邻近施工围挡的既有建筑。
scenes.title: Building elements beside construction / 邻近施工建筑构件

scenes.en: Record inclination at selected rigid frame members of modular site buildings or temporary accommodation. Establish a baseline after positioning and document the supporting arrangement. Comparing point histories with relocation, loading changes and support inspections helps facilities teams review local angle changes during the building’s planned period of use at that site.
scenes.zh: 在模块化临建或现场宿舍的选定刚性框架构件上记录倾角。就位后建立基准，并记录支撑布置；将点位历史与搬迁、荷载变化及支撑检查记录对照，帮助设施团队在该场地的计划使用期内，持续复核所选构件的局部角度变化。
scenes.pointen: A rigid frame column or beam designated in the monitoring layout.
scenes.pointzh: 监测布置指定的刚性框架立柱或横梁。
scenes.briefen: Module layout; support and anchorage details; relocation plan; intended occupancy period.
scenes.briefzh: 模块布置；支承与锚固信息；搬迁计划；计划使用周期。
scenes.imagebrief: 真实工地模块化房屋斜侧面摄影，展示完整箱式单元、钢框架及地面支承，环境整洁可信。
scenes.alten: Modular site buildings with visible frame and ground supports.
scenes.altzh: 模块化临建的框架与地面支承。
scenes.title: Modular buildings & site accommodation supports / 临建与模块化房屋支撑

introen: Connect local angle trends with individual asset records across road lighting, traffic systems, power networks, telecommunications and outdoor signage. Define the monitored member and installation baseline so maintenance teams can compare the same point over time.
introzh: 围绕路灯、交通立杆、电力杆塔、通信塔和户外广告设施，将测点倾角与具体资产关联。先明确被测构件和安装基准，再对照维护、天气与周边作业记录，持续观察相同位置的角度变化。
title: Poles, towers & outdoor signage / 杆体塔架与户外设施

scenes.en: Follow changes in angle at a selected point on each street-light pole, from urban roads to industrial parks. Link readings to the pole identifier and commissioning baseline. Maintenance teams can compare persistent changes with inspection records, nearby excavation and severe-weather events, helping them decide which poles need a closer on-site assessment.
scenes.zh: 在城市道路、园区或厂区的指定路灯杆位置持续观察倾角，并将读数对应到灯杆编号与安装基准。维护团队可结合巡检记录、邻近开挖和强风天气资料，比较同一测点的持续变化，为安排现场复查提供依据。成片部署时，清晰的资产编号也便于追踪具体杆位。
scenes.pointen: A rigid point on the specified pole section, clear of movable luminaire fittings.
scenes.pointzh: 指定灯杆区段的刚性点位，避开可调灯具连接件。
scenes.briefen: Pole material and diameter; pole identification plan; nearby excavation schedule; maintenance access; reporting requirements.
scenes.briefzh: 杆体材质与直径；灯杆编号方案；邻近开挖安排；维护通行条件；上报要求。
scenes.imagebrief: 真实城市道路路灯全景，前景完整呈现灯杆与底座，背景依次延伸同类灯杆，清晨自然光。
scenes.alten: Street-light poles and their bases along an urban road.
scenes.altzh: 城市道路旁的路灯杆及底座。
scenes.title: Street-light poles / 路灯杆

scenes.en: Observe local inclination on poles carrying traffic cameras, roadside monitoring equipment or intersection devices. Record the measurement axis and baseline against the pole asset record. Angle trends can support inspections after equipment replacement, foundation-area works or vehicle impact, with the monitored pole section distinguished from adjustable camera brackets and equipment mounts.
scenes.zh: 在交通摄像机、路侧监控设备或路口设备的立杆上，记录指定位置的倾角变化，并将测量方向和基准纳入杆体资产档案。结合设备更换、基础周边施工及车辆碰撞后的检查，帮助运维人员比较局部角度变化。监测位置应明确对应杆体，避免与可调摄像机支架混为一体。
scenes.pointen: The specified pole section supporting the roadside equipment.
scenes.pointzh: 承载路侧设备的指定杆体区段。
scenes.briefen: Pole and crossarm drawings; attached equipment changes; roadside access restrictions; impact history; asset-platform interface.
scenes.briefzh: 杆体及横臂图纸；附挂设备变更；道路作业限制；碰撞检查记录；资产平台接口。
scenes.imagebrief: 真实城市路口监控立杆，完整呈现杆身、横臂与摄像机，底座清楚可辨，路侧平视构图。
scenes.alten: Roadside camera pole with a crossarm and visible base.
scenes.altzh: 设有横臂与摄像机的路侧监控立杆。
scenes.title: Traffic and surveillance poles / 智慧交通与监控立杆

scenes.en: Track slow angular changes at designated members of a transmission tower. Associate each sensor with its member, measurement direction and installation baseline, then review trends alongside foundation surveys and tower inspections. Plan installation with the asset owner, including electrical-clearance requirements and permitted access, to obtain repeatable measurements from the intended structural location.
scenes.zh: 在输电塔指定构件上监测缓慢的局部转角，将每台传感器与构件位置、测量方向和安装基准对应。角度趋势可与基础测绘及塔架巡检记录一起查看，为分析维护阶段或周边工程期间的变化提供资料。安装作业须由产权或运维单位许可，并落实电气安全距离及现场通行要求。
scenes.pointen: A tower member identified in the structural monitoring plan.
scenes.pointzh: 结构监测方案指定的塔架构件。
scenes.briefen: Tower type and member designation; foundation survey plan; owner-approved installation procedure; electrical work restrictions; communications coverage.
scenes.briefzh: 塔型与构件编号；基础测绘方案；业主批准的安装流程；电气作业限制；通信覆盖。
scenes.imagebrief: 真实钢结构输电塔，低机位呈现完整塔身与塔脚，绝缘子及导线清晰，开阔地自然光。
scenes.alten: Steel transmission tower with visible legs, insulators and overhead conductors.
scenes.altzh: 塔脚与绝缘子清晰的钢结构输电塔。
scenes.title: Transmission towers / 输电塔

scenes.en: Build local inclination records for selected distribution poles along urban, rural or industrial feeders. Tie measurements to pole numbers and a consistent baseline, allowing teams to review changes around roadworks, drainage changes or pole-mounted equipment servicing. Pole condition and foundation observations give the angle record its site context for maintenance planning.
scenes.zh: 针对城市、乡村及工业园区配电线路的选定杆位，建立与电杆编号对应的局部倾角记录。以一致的测点与基准，比较道路施工、周边排水变化或杆上设备检修前后的角度。运维人员可结合杆体状态和基础观察安排检查；安装与作业条件由电力设施管理单位统一确认。
scenes.pointen: The designated rigid section of the distribution pole.
scenes.pointzh: 配电杆上指定的刚性杆段。
scenes.briefen: Pole material and number; pole-mounted equipment layout; roadside drainage conditions; utility access permissions; feeder maintenance schedule.
scenes.briefzh: 电杆材质与编号；杆上设备布置；道路排水条件；电力作业许可；线路检修安排。
scenes.imagebrief: 真实乡村或园区配电线路，前景电杆从底座到横担完整呈现，背景线路连续，地面环境清晰。
scenes.alten: Distribution poles with crossarms along a rural roadside.
scenes.altzh: 乡村道路沿线的配电杆与横担。
scenes.title: Distribution utility poles / 配电杆

scenes.en: Monitor inclination at a defined member or mast section of a telecommunications site. Compare the same mounting point before and after antenna work, equipment changes or maintenance activities. Combining the angle record with tower inspections and external weather observations helps distributed site teams review persistent changes while keeping each measurement tied to its specific structural location.
scenes.zh: 在通信站点指定塔架构件或桅杆区段监测倾角，持续比较相同安装点在天线作业、设备调整和维护前后的读数。将角度记录与塔架巡检及外部天气资料对照，便于分布式站点团队查看持续变化。每个测点保留具体构件标识，帮助后续维护人员理解读数所对应的位置。
scenes.pointen: A defined mast section or tower member, separate from adjustable antenna mounts.
scenes.pointzh: 指定桅杆区段或塔架构件，避开可调天线支架。
scenes.briefen: Tower or mast layout; monitored member; antenna modification schedule; site access arrangements; maintenance-platform requirements.
scenes.briefzh: 塔架或桅杆布局；被测构件；天线改造安排；站点通行条件；运维平台要求。
scenes.imagebrief: 真实蜂窝通信塔全景，天线面板与塔身结构清楚，前景留出塔脚或检修区域，蓝天自然光。
scenes.alten: Telecom tower with antenna panels and clearly visible structural members.
scenes.altzh: 天线面板与塔架构件清晰的通信塔。
scenes.title: Telecom towers / 通信塔

scenes.en: Observe angular changes at a selected billboard support pole or frame member. Establish a baseline for the monitored point and review trends alongside wind records, panel replacement and foundation-area works. Clearly identifying the support member helps maintenance teams compare local structural changes across inspections, especially where large sign panels are exposed to changing outdoor conditions.
scenes.zh: 在广告牌支撑杆或框架的指定位置观察角度变化，建立与测点一致的安装基准。维护团队可将趋势与风况、广告面板更换及基础周边施工记录相互对照，比较历次检查之间的变化。对迎风面积较大的户外广告设施，应清晰区分被测支撑构件与可更换面板的位置。
scenes.pointen: The selected support column or rigid frame member.
scenes.pointzh: 选定的支撑柱或刚性框架构件。
scenes.briefen: Sign panel dimensions; support-frame drawings; panel replacement schedule; exposure and access; foundation inspection records.
scenes.briefzh: 广告面板尺寸；支撑框架图纸；面板更换安排；户外暴露与通行条件；基础检查记录。
scenes.imagebrief: 真实道路旁单柱广告牌，完整呈现空白面板、支撑柱、斜撑与底部，远离夸张变形和危险倾斜。
scenes.alten: Single-column roadside billboard with its supporting frame and base.
scenes.altzh: 支撑框架与底座完整的单柱户外广告牌。
scenes.title: Billboard support poles / 广告牌支撑杆

introen: Follow angle changes at carefully defined points on historic structures, buildings and trees. Coordinate mounting with the responsible conservation, structural or tree-care team, and interpret trends alongside condition surveys, maintenance records and relevant environmental observations.
introzh: 在古建、危旧建筑与树木上明确测点，持续记录局部角度变化。安装方案与文保、结构或树木管理人员协同制定，趋势结合状态检查、维护记录及环境观察分析，兼顾保护要求和长期可比性。
title: Heritage structures, buildings & trees / 文保建筑与树木

scenes.en: Record slow angular changes at selected structural points on ancient pagodas and protected buildings. Establish a documented baseline with the conservation team and compare readings through repair stages or seasonal changes. Approved mounting and repeatable measurement directions help the team connect local angle trends with survey records and the conservation history of the monitored structure.
scenes.zh: 在古塔及受保护建筑的指定结构点位记录缓慢倾角变化，与文保团队共同建立并保存测量基准。在修缮阶段或季节变化期间持续比较相同点位，将局部角度趋势与测绘及保护修缮记录相互对照。固定方案须符合文保批准的可逆安装要求，并保留测点与安装方向档案。
scenes.pointen: A conservation-approved location on the specified structural element.
scenes.pointzh: 指定结构构件上经文保批准的固定位置。
scenes.briefen: Conservation designation; approved reversible mounting; selected structural points; previous surveys; repair-stage monitoring period.
scenes.briefzh: 文保等级与管理要求；批准的可逆固定方式；指定结构测点；既有测绘资料；修缮监测时段。
scenes.imagebrief: 真实古塔或传统文保建筑，完整塔身与基座清晰，侧向自然光呈现砖石细节，环境朴实可信。
scenes.alten: Historic masonry pagoda with a clearly visible tower body and base.
scenes.altzh: 塔身与基座清晰可见的历史砖石古塔。
scenes.title: Ancient pagodas and heritage structures / 古塔与文保结构

scenes.en: Observe local rotation at defined points on historic masonry walls, city walls or remaining wall sections. Keep the measurement direction and baseline consistent so conservation specialists can compare trends with crack mapping, drainage observations and repair records. Choose mounting locations and reversible attachment methods within the approved conservation plan for the original fabric.
scenes.zh: 在古建砌体墙、城墙或遗存墙段的指定位置观察局部转角，保持测量方向和基准一致。文保人员可将趋势与裂缝分布、排水观察及修缮记录对照，持续了解同一墙段的角度变化。测点与可逆固定方式纳入保护方案，由保护团队批准，兼顾原有砖石及表面材料的保护要求。
scenes.pointen: A defined wall section at a conservation-approved attachment location.
scenes.pointzh: 指定墙段上经文保批准的固定位置。
scenes.briefen: Wall construction and surface condition; crack survey; drainage context; permitted attachment; conservation access restrictions.
scenes.briefzh: 墙体构造与表面状态；裂缝测绘；排水环境；允许的固定方式；文保通行限制。
scenes.imagebrief: 真实古城墙或历史砖石墙段，近景呈现砌筑纹理与墙顶轮廓，侧面可见墙体走势和排水环境。
scenes.alten: Historic masonry wall with visible brickwork and a continuous wall profile.
scenes.altzh: 砖石纹理与墙体走势清晰的历史墙段。
scenes.title: Historic masonry walls / 古建砌体墙与城墙

scenes.en: Follow inclination at an identified timber column or beam location in a historic frame. Record the member, mounting orientation and baseline before comparing readings across conservation work or seasonal conditions. The local record helps specialists examine that member's angular changes alongside frame surveys and joint inspections, using an attachment approved for the historic timber surface.
scenes.zh: 在古建木构的指定柱段或梁体位置观察倾角，记录构件编号、安装方向与测量基准。保护人员可比较修缮阶段和季节变化中的读数，结合木构测绘及节点检查，分析该测点所在构件的角度变化。固定方式由文保团队根据原有木材表面与保护要求批准，保留可复核的测点档案。
scenes.pointen: The selected timber column or beam at an approved attachment point.
scenes.pointzh: 指定木柱或梁体上经批准的固定点。
scenes.briefen: Timber member identification; joint and frame survey; surface protection rules; approved attachment; repair sequence.
scenes.briefzh: 木构件编号；节点与构架测绘；表面保护要求；批准的固定方式；修缮工序。
scenes.imagebrief: 真实传统建筑内部木构梁柱，清楚呈现一根立柱与梁枋节点，自然侧光，保留木材岁月质感。
scenes.alten: Historic timber column and beam joints inside a traditional building.
scenes.altzh: 传统建筑内部的历史木柱与梁枋节点。
scenes.title: Historic timber frames / 古建木构梁柱

scenes.en: Monitor local angular changes at structural points selected by the responsible engineer in a distressed or ageing building. Compare a documented baseline through assessment, stabilisation and repair stages. Combined with crack observations and independent surveys, the angle record adds a consistent point-based history for engineering review and the site's agreed inspection and notification procedures.
scenes.zh: 在工程师指定的危旧或结构受损建筑测点监测局部转角，以完整基准记录比较评估、临时稳定及修复各阶段的变化。将倾角趋势与裂缝观察和独立测绘相互对照，为工程复核提供连续的点位记录。安装、巡检与通知安排遵从项目现场方案，并明确每个读数所对应的结构构件。
scenes.pointen: An engineer-selected load-bearing wall, column or other structural member.
scenes.pointzh: 工程师选定的承重墙、柱或其他结构构件。
scenes.briefen: Assessment and stabilisation stage; authorised access; selected members; crack and survey records; inspection escalation procedure.
scenes.briefzh: 评估与临时稳定阶段；授权通行条件；指定构件；裂缝与测绘资料；巡检升级流程。
scenes.imagebrief: 真实老旧砌体建筑，局部裂缝自然可信，外侧有规范临时支撑与隔离区域，避免倒塌灾难画面。
scenes.alten: Ageing masonry building with temporary supports and a controlled assessment area.
scenes.altzh: 设有临时支撑与评估隔离区域的老旧建筑。
scenes.title: Structurally distressed buildings / 危旧与结构受损建筑

scenes.en: Keep a local trunk-angle record for a selected veteran or heritage tree, with the monitoring point agreed by a qualified tree-care specialist. Compare persistent changes with external wind observations, ground inspections and conservation work. Document the attachment position and schedule checks and adjustments as the tree grows, following the specialist's approved installation and care plan.
scenes.zh: 由树木专业人员确定古树名木的监测位置，建立选定树干点位的倾角记录。持续变化可与外部风况、地面检查和养护记录对照，便于保护团队了解不同阶段的局部姿态。固定方式须经专业人员批准，并记录位置，随树木生长定期检查和调整，落实相应的保护与养护要求。
scenes.pointen: A specialist-selected trunk location with an approved, inspectable attachment.
scenes.pointzh: 专业人员选定、固定装置可定期检查的树干位置。
scenes.briefen: Tree identity and protection requirements; specialist-approved attachment; trunk growth allowance; conservation records; external weather observations.
scenes.briefzh: 古树编号与保护要求；专业批准的固定方式；生长调整空间；养护记录；外部天气资料。
scenes.imagebrief: 真实公园古树，完整呈现粗壮树干、根颈与部分树冠，保护围栏自然入镜，清晨柔和光线。
scenes.alten: Veteran tree showing its trunk, root flare and conservation surroundings.
scenes.altzh: 树干、根颈及保护环境清晰的古树。
scenes.title: Veteran and heritage trees / 古树名木

scenes.en: Associate trunk-angle measurements with individual street-tree records along roads, squares or pedestrian routes. Follow the same selected point through nearby roadworks, landscaping changes and seasonal conditions, and review persistent trends with arboricultural inspections and external wind records. A specialist-approved attachment, documented position and scheduled growth adjustments help maintain a useful, comparable local record.
scenes.zh: 在道路、广场及步行区域，将指定树干测点的倾角与单株行道树档案关联。持续对照邻近道路施工、绿化调整与季节变化期间的读数，并结合树木检查及外部风况查看趋势。由树木专业人员批准固定方式，记录具体位置，按生长情况定期检查和调整，以保持同点位记录可比。
scenes.pointen: The identified trunk point for each tree in the monitoring plan.
scenes.pointzh: 监测方案中逐株标识的树干点位。
scenes.briefen: Street-tree inventory; pedestrian and road access; nearby excavation; arboricultural inspection plan; attachment inspection and adjustment schedule.
scenes.briefzh: 行道树资产清单；人行与道路通行条件；邻近开挖；树木检查计划；固定装置检查调整周期。
scenes.imagebrief: 真实城市步道旁行道树，前景树干及树池完整，背景排列连续，展示道路与根部周边真实关系。
scenes.alten: Urban street trees beside a pedestrian path with visible tree pits.
scenes.altzh: 步道旁树干与树池清晰的城市行道树。
scenes.title: Urban street trees / 城市行道树

introen: Connect rack locations, structural supports and selected machine bases to a documented angle reference. Use comparable loading or stationary machine conditions to help teams review persistent changes after installation, operational changes or maintenance.
introzh: 将货架位置、支承构件和选定设备底座与倾角基准对应。结合可对照的荷载或设备静止工况，查看安装、运行调整与维护前后的持续变化。
title: Warehousing & factory equipment / 仓储与工厂设备

scenes.en: Monitor inclination at selected pallet-rack uprights and associate each point with its aisle, bay and level reference. Compare persistent changes with loading records, handling activity and scheduled rack inspections. A documented mounting position helps the warehouse team identify which upright needs review after a reported impact, rack adjustment or change in use.
scenes.zh: 在指定托盘货架立柱上监测倾角，将点位与巷道、货位和安装高度关联。结合装载记录、搬运作业和货架巡检，查看持续出现的变化；发生碰撞报告、货架调整或用途改变后，帮助仓储团队找到需要复核的具体立柱。
scenes.pointen: A rigid fixing on the selected rack upright, clear of handling contact.
scenes.pointzh: 选定货架立柱上与构件可靠固定、避开搬运碰撞的位置。
scenes.briefen: Rack layout, upright section, loading pattern, impact records, inspection ownership.
scenes.briefzh: 货架布局、立柱截面、装载方式、碰撞记录、巡检负责人。
scenes.imagebrief: 真实完整托盘货架通道，立柱和底部固定清晰；画面保留货物与搬运净空，不只拍局部金属件。
scenes.alten: Pallet racks with visible uprights and base fixings along a warehouse aisle.
scenes.altzh: 仓库通道两侧的托盘货架、立柱与底部固定。
scenes.title: Warehouse pallet racking / 仓库托盘货架

scenes.en: Track local inclination at defined uprights within an automated high-bay warehouse. Identify each point by rack row and service location so changes can be reviewed with loading, maintenance and equipment-interaction records. Choose accessible fixing positions outside stacker-crane and shuttle operating envelopes, with a repeatable baseline for the selected structural member.
scenes.zh: 在自动化立体库选定立柱上观察局部倾角，并按货架排号和检修位置标识。结合装载、维护和设备作业记录查看变化；传感器固定在堆垛机、穿梭车运行范围之外，并为被测构件建立可复核的基准，便于检修团队定位检查。
scenes.pointen: An approved high-bay rack upright outside moving-equipment clearances.
scenes.pointzh: 自动化负责人认可、避开运动设备净空的货架立柱。
scenes.briefen: Rack height, access restrictions, crane clearances, loading states, point identification.
scenes.briefzh: 货架高度、检修限制、堆垛机净空、荷载状态、点位编号。
scenes.imagebrief: 高位立体仓库全景，清楚展示货架立柱、堆垛机与通道；不以普通货架或无人叉车代替完整系统。
scenes.alten: High-bay warehouse racks beside a stacker-crane aisle.
scenes.altzh: 自动化立体库货架及堆垛机通道。
scenes.title: Automated high-bay racking / 自动化立体库货架

scenes.en: Observe inclination at selected columns supporting an industrial mezzanine or storage platform. Associate the angle history with the column grid, platform use and documented load changes. The records help the facilities team plan inspection of the named member after layout alterations, equipment relocation or maintenance affecting the support arrangement.
scenes.zh: 在工业夹层或仓储平台的选定支承柱上观察倾角，按柱网编号记录，并结合平台用途和已知荷载变化进行对照。布局调整、设备搬迁或支撑维护前后的数据，可帮助设施团队安排对具体构件及连接部位的检查。
scenes.pointen: A structural column location selected in the platform monitoring plan.
scenes.pointzh: 平台监测方案指定的结构立柱位置。
scenes.briefen: Column grid, platform loads, connection details, altered layouts, inspection access.
scenes.briefzh: 柱网、平台荷载、连接形式、布局变动、巡检条件。
scenes.imagebrief: 真实厂房内的完整钢结构夹层平台，立柱、梁和楼梯关系清晰；避免将立柱外装饰面作为测点示意。
scenes.alten: Steel mezzanine platform with visible support columns inside a factory.
scenes.altzh: 厂房内的钢结构夹层平台及支承立柱。
scenes.title: Industrial mezzanine columns / 工业夹层平台立柱

scenes.en: Compare static inclination at a selected injection-moulding machine base before and after installation, relocation or maintenance. Record the machine state and mounting reference so later observations represent comparable conditions. The trend gives the maintenance team an additional record when reviewing the base orientation alongside the machine supplier's levelling checks and service procedures.
scenes.zh: 在注塑机选定底座点位，对比安装、搬迁或维护前后的静态倾角。记录设备状态和固定基准，使历次读数具有可比性；结合设备厂家的调平检查及维护流程，为维修团队复核底座姿态变化提供一份连续的点位记录。
scenes.pointen: An approved rigid machine-base surface, measured in comparable stationary conditions.
scenes.pointzh: 设备方认可的刚性底座表面，在可比静止工况下测量。
scenes.briefen: Base design, approved fixing, levelling process, stopped state, thermal conditions.
scenes.briefzh: 底座结构、允许固定方式、调平流程、静止工况、温度条件。
scenes.imagebrief: 完整真实注塑机及其底座，展示设备全貌和维护侧空间；不只拍模具、钻头或通用机器人。
scenes.alten: Complete injection-moulding machine with its base and maintenance-side access.
scenes.altzh: 完整注塑机、设备底座及维护侧空间。
scenes.title: Injection-moulding machine bases / 注塑机底座

scenes.en: Observe static orientation at defined points on a heavy machine-tool base or supporting frame. Compare readings in agreed stopped conditions, with the same carriage or workpiece arrangement where relevant. Use the angle history alongside the manufacturer's geometry checks to review persistent changes after foundation work, machine relocation or scheduled servicing.
scenes.zh: 在重型机床底座或支承框架的指定点位观察静态姿态。在约定的停机状态下比较读数，必要时保持相同的滑台或工件布置；结合厂家的几何检查，复核基础作业、设备搬迁和定期检修后持续出现的角度变化。
scenes.pointen: A manufacturer-approved rigid base location representing the selected orientation.
scenes.pointzh: 厂家认可、能够代表所需方向的刚性底座位置。
scenes.briefen: Machine type, carriage position, load arrangement, thermal state, reference checks.
scenes.briefzh: 机床类型、滑台位置、荷载布置、温度状态、基准检查。
scenes.imagebrief: 重型龙门或大型机床全貌，底座与支承关系清楚；画面保留地面基础和维护通道，避免仅用切削特写。
scenes.alten: Heavy gantry machine tool with a visible structural base and factory floor.
scenes.altzh: 重型龙门机床及其结构底座与厂房地面。
scenes.title: Heavy machine-tool bases / 重型机床底座

scenes.en: Follow slow inclination changes at selected fixed frames supporting a production line. Give each measurement a station and member reference, and compare it across documented installation or maintenance stages. In agreed stationary conditions, the records help teams review frame orientation after line reconfiguration, support adjustments or works affecting the surrounding floor.
scenes.zh: 在固定生产线的选定支承框架上跟踪缓慢倾角变化，将测点对应到工位和具体构件，并按安装或维护阶段记录基准。在约定的静止工况下，对照产线改造、支撑调整和周边地面作业前后的框架姿态，辅助安排复核。
scenes.pointen: A fixed load-bearing frame member, away from moving tooling and covers.
scenes.pointzh: 固定承重框架构件，避开运动工装及可拆护罩。
scenes.briefen: Frame layout, station identifiers, stopped conditions, support adjustments, service access.
scenes.briefzh: 框架布局、工位编号、静止工况、支撑调整、维护空间。
scenes.imagebrief: 完整固定式生产线及承重机架，能辨认工位与支撑柱；不以运转机械臂或传送带局部代表倾角测点。
scenes.alten: Fixed production-line support frames and maintenance access inside an industrial hall.
scenes.altzh: 工业厂房内的固定产线框架及维护通道。
scenes.title: Fixed production-line frames / 固定生产线框架

introen: Observe local rotation at selected supports in water, energy and plant infrastructure. Choose a rigid structural point, document its orientation and compare the trend with relevant loading, operating and inspection records for that particular member.
introzh: 围绕水务、能源和厂务设施的指定支承构件观察局部转角。选择刚性结构点并记录方向，结合对应荷载、运行状态与巡检记录分析变化。
title: Energy & municipal support structures / 能源与市政支承结构

scenes.en: Monitor inclination at selected columns or other supporting members of an elevated water tank. Connect each reading to the member and mounting height, then review changes with operating water levels, maintenance and survey records. Comparable loading observations help the facilities team distinguish repeatable operating patterns from persistent changes requiring further inspection.
scenes.zh: 在水塔或高架水池选定立柱等支承构件上监测倾角，将读数与构件编号和安装高度关联。结合运行水位、维护与测绘记录，对照可比荷载条件下的变化，帮助设施团队区分重复出现的运行表现与需要进一步检查的持续变化。
scenes.pointen: An engineer-selected rigid support member with a documented mounting orientation.
scenes.pointzh: 工程师选定、安装方向明确的刚性支承构件。
scenes.briefen: Support design, water-level records, mounting height, access, survey references.
scenes.briefzh: 支承结构、水位记录、安装高度、检修条件、测绘基准。
scenes.imagebrief: 完整高架水池或水塔，主体与支承柱均清晰；避免将水位读数、液位探头或内部水面作为倾角照片。
scenes.alten: Elevated water tank with visible structural support columns.
scenes.altzh: 高架水池及清晰可见的支承立柱。
scenes.title: Elevated water-tank supports / 水塔与高架水池支承

scenes.en: Follow orientation at selected load-bearing members of a fixed photovoltaic support system. Record the reference after installation and compare later angles with maintenance, ground works and weather records. Clearly identify the measured frame so teams can inspect a persistent local change while keeping panel setting and structural assessment within the project's engineering plan.
scenes.zh: 在固定式光伏支架的选定承重构件上观察姿态，安装后建立基准，并结合维护、地面作业和天气记录对照后续倾角。将每个点位对应到明确支架，便于对持续局部变化安排检查，相关组件角度与结构评估按工程方案开展。
scenes.pointen: A fixed support post or load-bearing frame representing the monitored orientation.
scenes.pointzh: 能够代表监测方向的固定支柱或承重框架。
scenes.briefen: Fixed-frame design, foundation layout, reference orientation, ground works, weather exposure.
scenes.briefzh: 固定支架形式、基础布局、基准方向、地面作业、气候暴露。
scenes.imagebrief: 真实固定式光伏阵列，侧视呈现固定立柱、斜梁和地面基础；不使用太阳跟踪转轴或将传感器贴在薄电池片上。
scenes.alten: Fixed photovoltaic arrays with visible posts, inclined frames and ground foundations.
scenes.altzh: 固定式光伏阵列的立柱、斜梁及地面基础。
scenes.title: Fixed photovoltaic supports / 固定式光伏支架

scenes.en: Track local inclination at selected support legs or frames beneath a silo or tank. Relate the point history to documented filling states, maintenance and support inspections. The selected angle record helps engineering teams review a particular member through comparable loading conditions, with vessel geometry and any required deformation measurements addressed by the wider project.
scenes.zh: 在料仓或储罐选定支腿、支架上跟踪局部倾角，并结合进出料状态、维护及支承检查记录进行对照。明确被测构件与可比荷载条件，为工程团队复核支承姿态提供点位数据；罐体几何和其他变形测量结合整体方案另行设计。
scenes.pointen: An accessible engineer-approved support leg or frame outside the process boundary.
scenes.pointzh: 工艺边界外、便于检修且经工程师认可的支腿或框架。
scenes.briefen: Support arrangement, filling states, temperatures, area classification, fixing access.
scenes.briefzh: 支承布置、装料状态、温度、区域分类、固定与检修条件。
scenes.imagebrief: 完整料仓或立式罐体及其外部支腿，支架和基础清晰；不只拍罐壁，也不将产品放入物料或工艺介质中。
scenes.alten: Industrial silo or tank supported by visible external legs and structural framing.
scenes.altzh: 工业料仓或储罐及其外部支腿与框架。
scenes.title: Silo and tank support frames / 料仓与储罐支承框架

scenes.en: Observe local angular changes at an approved structural location near an industrial chimney base. Keep the measurement tied to that member and reference direction, and review it with thermal operating states, maintenance and survey observations. An accessible fixing outside hot surfaces supports repeatable checks of the selected location over the monitoring period.
scenes.zh: 在工业烟囱基部经确认的结构位置观察局部角度变化，将测量明确对应到该构件和基准方向。结合运行温度状态、维护与测绘记录进行对照；在避开高温、便于检修的位置固定，有助于在监测期间重复检查同一部位。
scenes.pointen: An approved rigid base member within the selected configuration's environmental conditions.
scenes.pointzh: 环境条件适合所选配置、经认可的刚性基部构件。
scenes.briefen: Base design, thermal exposure, operating states, access, complementary survey.
scenes.briefzh: 基部结构、热暴露、运行状态、检修条件、配套测绘。
scenes.imagebrief: 真实工业烟囱完整外观及基部结构，镜头保留地面检修区域；不在烟气内或高温内壁模拟传感器安装。
scenes.alten: Industrial chimney and its accessible external base structure.
scenes.altzh: 工业烟囱及可检修的外部基部结构。
scenes.title: Industrial chimney base structures / 工业烟囱基部结构

scenes.en: Monitor inclination at selected structural supports beneath an industrial cooling tower. Document the fixing position and compare observations under agreed operating and loading conditions, including relevant fan and water-system states. The resulting trend helps maintenance teams review persistent support changes alongside connection inspections, maintenance interventions and the site's structural monitoring records.
scenes.zh: 在工业冷却塔选定支承构件上监测倾角，记录固定位置，在相同风机及水系统状态、角度读数稳定的观测时段进行比较。结合连接部位检查、维护作业和结构监测记录，帮助维修团队复核持续出现的支承变化。
scenes.pointen: An engineer-selected fixed support, with operating disturbance assessed for the installation.
scenes.pointzh: 工程师选定的固定支承，安装时评估运行扰动。
scenes.briefen: Support layout, fan states, moisture exposure, loading conditions, service access.
scenes.briefzh: 支承布局、风机状态、潮湿暴露、荷载条件、维护通道。
scenes.imagebrief: 完整工业冷却塔与固定支承框架，展示检修空间及支柱；不以风机叶片、传动轴或振动探头特写代替。
scenes.alten: Industrial cooling tower mounted on a visible fixed support frame.
scenes.altzh: 安装于固定支承框架上的工业冷却塔。
scenes.title: Cooling-tower support frames / 冷却塔支承框架

scenes.en: Follow local inclination at selected columns supporting an industrial utility pipe rack. Identify the frame, elevation and mounting direction so readings can be reviewed with pipe modifications, thermal operating states and maintenance records. Use the history to guide inspection of the monitored member after support works or changes to the services carried above it.
scenes.zh: 在工业厂务管廊选定立柱上跟踪局部倾角，标明框架编号、安装高度和测量方向。结合管线改造、热工运行状态与维护记录，查看支撑作业或上部管线配置变化前后的趋势，为检查对应结构构件提供明确的点位记录。
scenes.pointen: A fixed structural column rather than a moving pipe, insulation or removable cover.
scenes.pointzh: 固定结构立柱，测点与管道、保温层及可拆盖板分开。
scenes.briefen: Frame grid, carried services, thermal states, area classification, fixing details.
scenes.briefzh: 框架轴网、承载管线、热工状态、区域分类、固定细节。
scenes.imagebrief: 厂区完整多层管廊及承重立柱，管架与管道层次清楚；避免只拍保温管或将随管热胀的支架误作结构基准。
scenes.alten: Industrial utility pipe rack with multiple service lines and visible structural columns.
scenes.altzh: 多层厂务管廊、服务管线与承重立柱。
scenes.title: Utility pipe-rack columns / 厂务管廊立柱
